title: Send one prompt to 6 AI models and compare their answers with AskAnyModel for $31.99
excerpt: One prompt, six opinions, your pick.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get a lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro for $31.99 (reg. $499) with code DEAL20 through November 15 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

Credit: AskAnyModel

$31.99
$499 Save $467.01

Why settle for one AI answer when you can compare six? AskAnyModel AI Pro lets you send a single prompt to up to six models simultaneously, then view their responses side by side. Instead of opening separate tabs and switching between subscriptions, you can see where different models agree, where they disagree, and which response best fits what you’re trying to accomplish. You can get it for an additional 20% off when you use the coupon code DEAL20 at checkout, making the final price $31.99 (reg. $499).

This platform brings over 50 AI models together in one place, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Llama, and Mistral. You can switch models in the middle of a conversation, with responses streaming in real time. That flexibility makes it easier to pick the right tool for the task rather than defaulting to whichever chatbot you happen to have open.

There’s also a distinction between the plan’s standard and premium access. You get unlimited chats with 30 standard models, along with unlimited AI image generation across multiple models. For the 19 flagship models, the plan provides 500 premium credits each month, which refresh regularly rather than running as a one-time allotment.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

For developers, researchers, marketers, and other people who rely on AI throughout the workday, having multiple models available in one place can make comparing ideas and checking responses a more practical part of the process. It’s also an alternative to maintaining several separate AI subscriptions, each with its own monthly bill.

AskAnyModel runs in a modern browser, so there’s no software to download. And instead of another recurring payment, this is a lifetime subscription for a one-time purchase. The regular $499 price is currently down to $39.99, or $31.99 with code DEAL20 at checkout.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

If comparing AI responses sounds useful to your workflow, get AskAnyModel AI Pro for $31.99 before the promotion ends November 15 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
